description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes and accuracy for two different models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with numeric tick marks placed at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The plot contains two lines representing the performance of the models. The line for GPT-4o is a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at a value of 24.4 at an x-value of 1, increases to 28.9 at an x-value of 3, reaches a peak of 34.4 at an x-value of 5, and then declines to end at 31.1 at an x-value of 7. The line for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is a solid light blue line with 'x' shaped markers; it starts at 26.7 at an x-value of 1, rises slightly to a peak of 27.8 at an x-value of 3, decreases to 24.4 at an x-value of 5, and continues to decline, ending at 20.0 at an x-value of 7.
